titel: Find holes in your model before you print 🔍 #blender #3dprinting
printzin: Every printer is different: print a small test first.

scenes.tekst: Does your slicer say your model has holes?
scenes.label: QUICK CHECK

scenes.tekst: Blender can find them for you in a few seconds, before you print.
scenes.label: TIP

scenes.tekst: Select your model, press Tab for Edit Mode, then 2 for edge select.
scenes.label: STEP 1
scenes.uitspraak: Select your model, press Tab for Edit Mode, then two for edge select.

scenes.tekst: Press Alt A, so nothing is selected.
scenes.label: STEP 2

scenes.tekst: Open Select, Select All by Trait, Non Manifold.
scenes.label: STEP 3
scenes.uitspraak: Open Select. Select All by Trait. Non-manifold.

scenes.tekst: Every edge that is not closed lights up. Here, a hole in the head of the pawn.
scenes.label: FOUND IT

scenes.tekst: Press F to fill the hole with a new face.
scenes.label: STEP 4

scenes.tekst: Run the check again with Shift Ctrl Alt M. Nothing lights up, so the mesh is closed.
scenes.label: CHECK AGAIN
scenes.uitspraak: Run the check again with Shift, Control, Alt, M. Nothing lights up, so the mesh is closed.

scenes.tekst: Every printer is different, so print a small test first. Save this for your next print.
scenes.label: PRINT FIRST

scenes.tekst: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
scenes.label: CLICK JOINTS PRO
scenes.uitspraak: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
